# Descriptions
@@ 1
Allows caster to mend on simple fracture (not compound fractures, shatters,
joint damage, etc.). Recovery time is 1-10 hours.
@@ 2
Allows caster to repair all cartilage damage around one joint. Recovery time
is 1-2 hours.
@@ 3
As Minor Fracture Repair, except that caster can also repair compound
fractures.
@@ 4
Allows caster to mend one fracture in his skull (but not a shattered area).
Recovery time is 1-10 hours.
@@ 5
Allows caster to repair one broken (but not shattered) joint. Recovery time is
1-10 hours.
@@ 6
As Minor Fracture Repair, except recovery is instantaneous.
@@ 7
Allows caster to reattach severed limb. Also requires the use of Blood Ways,
Muscle Ways, and Organ Ways Joining spells to restore limb to functional
status. Limb will be fulling functional in 1-10 days.
@@ 8
As Cartilage Repair, except recovery is instantaneous.
@@ 9
As Major Fracture Repair, except recovery is instantaneous.
@@ 10
As Skull Repair, except recovery is instantaneous.
@@ 11
As Joint Repair, except recovery is instantaneous.
@@ 12
Allows caster to repair any broken or shattered bone. Recovery time is 1-10
hours.
@@ 13
Caster can regenerate any one area of cartilage. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.
@@ 14
Caster can regenerate any one bone. Recovery time is 1-10 hours. This spell
will not work on the skull.
@@ 15
As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Healer Joining True spells and
recovery is instantaneous.
@@ 16
As Shatter Repair, except recovery time is 5-50 minutes.
@@ 17
As Cartilage Regeneration, except the recovery time is 5-50 minutes.
@@ 18
As Bone Regeneration, except will only work on the skull.
@@ 19
As Bone Regeneration, except recovery time is 5-50 minutes.
@@ 20
As Shatter Repair, except recovery is instantaneous.
@@ 25
As Cartilage Regeneration, except that caster can regenerate all of the lost
cartilage in his body. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.
@@ 30
As Bone Regeneration, except that caster can regenerate all of the lost bones
in his body (including his skull). Recovery time is 1-10 hours.
@@ 50
Caster can regenerate all of the lost bone and/or cartilage in his body.
Recovery is instantaneous.
